typography.font_install_instructions: Add Google Fonts links for Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans in index.html.

success.usage: Resolved status, Positive KPIs, Safe zones on map

warning.usage: In Progress status, Medium priority, Alerts

danger.usage: Critical priority, SLA breaches, High urgency map markers

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing for Citizen Portal, Control Room Density for Dashboards

components.buttons: rounded-md font-medium transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95. Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90.
components.cards: Never use soft dropshadows. Use crisp 1px borders (border-border). For hover states: -translate-y-1, shadow-md.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs. rounded-md, border-border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary.
components.badges: Used for statuses. Rounded-full, text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5.
components.map: Leaflet or Mapbox. Render with grayscale tiles to let data markers (Red/Orange/Yellow/Green) stand out.
components.data_testids: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='submit-report-btn')

icons.style: duotone for citizen portal, regular for dense dashboard tables

media_and_images.rules: Use the exact URLs below. Do not use placehold.it or via.placeholder.com.

micro_interactions.hover_states: Always explicitly define hover:text-color when using hover:bg-color.
micro_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching exactly the shape of the content to be loaded.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all HTML/JSX has proper semantic tags.
Implement a unified Layout component that handles navigation across Citizen, Officer, and Admin roles.
For the Citizen form, make the image/video upload prominent and mobile-friendly.
In the Dashboard tables, use color-coded badges for urgency/status exactly matching the provided Hex/HSL values.
Ensure the map implementation uses the provided status colors for markers.
All forms and interactive UI components MUST use data-testid attributes.
Run yarn add @phosphor-icons/react before utilizing the icons.
